Title: Dolphin Social Psych Science
========================================================


# Read in file and set up variables
```{r} 

library(lme4)
library(languageR)
require(boot)
setwd("/Users/jsulliv1/Desktop/UCSDProjects/AnalyzeWrite/Dolphin")
s = read.csv("Dolphin_Data_Social_ForR.csv",na.strings="na")
```

### Set up both participant and accuracy as binary
```{r}
s$Participant<-factor(s$Participant)
s$Accuracy<-factor(s$Accuracy) #treats the data as binary
```

### Set up data to separate by experiment (1 vs. 2) and to include only trials that were correct/incorrect
```{r}
exp1=subset(s,(s$TestType=="E1")) #find only the trials that were Exp. 1
exp1sub = subset(exp1, !is.na(Accuracy)) #finds only the trials that were Exp. 1 and had been coded as correct/incorrect
exp2=subset(s,(s$TestType=="E2")) #find only the trials that were Exp. 2
exp2sub = subset(exp2,!is.na(Accuracy)) #finds only the trials that were Exp. 2 and had been coded as correct/incorrect

exp1sub$AccNum = as.numeric(exp1sub$Accuracy) - 1 
```

#Now, we compare Exp. 1 performance to chance

```{r}
e1ac = glmer(Accuracy ~ (1|Participant),data=exp1sub,family=binomial)
summary(e1ac)
```

Check modeled accuracy rate (and ensure it's close enough to the true mean)
```{r}
inv.logit(fixef(e1ac))
```
Get real mean

```{r}
summary(exp1sub$Accuracy)
```

#Now, we compare Exp. 2 performance to chance

```{r}
exp2sub$AccNum = as.numeric(exp2sub$Accuracy) - 1
e2ac = glmer(Accuracy ~ (1|Participant),data=exp2sub,family=binomial)
summary(e2ac)
```

And get modeled accuracy rates
```{r}
inv.logit(fixef(e2ac))
```

Get real mean

```{r}
summary(exp2sub$Accuracy)
```


#Test for Order Effects in Exp. 1
```{r}

e1oealt = glmer(Accuracy ~ AnimalOrder + (1|Participant),data=exp1, family=binomial)
summary(e1oealt)

e1oealtminusorder = glmer(Accuracy ~ (1|Participant),data=exp1, family=binomial)
summary(e1oealtminusorder )

anova(e1oealt, e1oealtminusorder)
```



#Test for Order Effects in Exp. 2

```{r}
e2oealt = glmer(Accuracy ~ AnimalOrder + (1|Participant),data=exp2, family=binomial)
summary(e2oealt)
e2oealtminusorder = glmer(Accuracy ~  (1|Participant),data=exp2, family=binomial)
anova(e2oealt,e2oealtminusorder)
```
